purpose: Pre-specify the repaired confirmatory analysis for FORMAL002 after FORMAL001 exposed a pre-existing acquisition-policy/evaluation-scope mismatch. This plan preserves the previously specified metrics and statistical tests, adds POLICY_BLOCKED eligibility rules, and does not modify M1/M2/M3 runtime.

rq1.design: Exhaustive census of the case-study ERP navigation structure against the independent Expert A reference.
rq1.reason_no_inferential_test: RQ1 is an exhaustive census of the bounded case-study ERP structure, not a random sample from a population of ERP screens.

policy_scope.primary_rule: POLICY_BLOCKED reference items do not enter TP/FP/FN for primary module, screen or screen_hierarchy metrics. They are reported separately and are not technical misses.
policy_scope.all_reference_transparency_diagnostic: Retain an explicitly non-primary all-reference route coverage diagnostic over all 65 functional reference screens.
policy_scope.unexpected_blocked_detection: A detected item under a blocked route prefix is reported as an acquisition-policy violation rather than silently treated as an ordinary true positive.

rq2.design: Paired PRE-HITL/POST-HITL evaluation over all formally eligible screens in the case study.
rq2.formal_generation_failures: Retain in denominators as not-available outputs; do not use survivor-only scoring.
rq2.inferential_role: Descriptive paired case-study evidence. Do not generalize to an external population of ERP screens from significance tests.

policy_scope.primary_rule: PRE/POST-HITL semantic quality denominators contain only screens included in the frozen semantic reference and authorized by the frozen acquisition policy.
policy_scope.eligible_missing_output_rule: Failure, timeout, abstention or unavailable output on an otherwise eligible route remains in the denominator as a not-available/zero-prediction output.

rq3.sample_size_rationale: Balanced coverage of all nine required strata with a feasible human-scoring workload. The 54-query bank is not presented as a power-based random sample from a broader ERP population.
rq3.primary_test_multiplicity_control: Holm adjustment across the two primary McNemar tests; family-wise alpha=0.05. These tests describe paired differences inside the frozen case-study bank and are not a claim of population-level confirmatory power.

secondary_graph_ablation.interpretation: Secondary/exploratory. Report unadjusted p-value with effect magnitude and interval; do not promote it to a primary confirmatory claim.

paired_bootstrap.factual_metric_rule: For each bootstrap replicate, resample query_ids and recompute aggregate TP/FP/FN within each paired condition before deriving precision/recall/F1. Do not drop queries because a condition produced zero claims.

latency_sensitivity_analysis.role: Secondary sensitivity analysis. Report paired median difference and bootstrap interval as the main effect description.

rq3.latency_percentile_method: p50 and p95 use deterministic linear interpolation at position (n-1)q on sorted per-query latencies.
rq3.by_stratum: Descriptive only. Report counts and metrics for each of the nine strata, but do not make stratum-level inferential significance claims because n=6 per stratum.

expert_B_secondary_scoring.subset_selection: Stratified subset frozen before scoring using the formal randomization seed.
expert_B_secondary_scoring.purpose: Agreement/robustness assessment only, with explicit caveat from prior formal HITL exposure.

inter_rater.agreement_statistic: Cohen's kappa for expected_behavior_correct on the frozen shared blinded subset, plus raw percent agreement. Report safety_compliant agreement separately on mutually rated mutative-safety items. Atomic claim-match disagreements are described rather than collapsed into the same kappa.

supersedes.reason: FORMAL001 demonstrated that the frozen acquisition policy deliberately excludes /admin/seguridad while the human references included eight functional Seguridad screens. v2 reconciles the scoring universe before FORMAL002.
